The intimate auditorium, seating 356 patrons, is a beautiful interior and boasts of top-quality acoustics. The vast lobby is perfect to host large groups for mingling pre- and post-show. In addition, the backstage consists of a large loading area, two private dressing rooms, one beautifully decorated green room, and a Hollywood-style dressing area.
